contract: Reviewed against frozen PHP Server 2.5.14, Workflow 2.5.5 and PHP SDK 2.2.6 on the six-configuration PHP/Rust/embedded matrix. The installed normal scheduler fires the original committed two-second UTC occurrence without moving clocks, editing rows or constructing history. One original authored echo workflow completes with exact Avro int64 input. Retain original schedule, occurrence deadline, generated workflow/run and schedule/root audit links; prohibit early firing. max_runs=1 deletes with max_runs_exhausted and clears next_fire_at while the original workflow can finish. Two later real intervals admit no extra fire or workflow; fresh original audit survives deletion. Controlled PHP maintenance sequences repair and evaluation; concurrent contention remains separately tracked in Server #355. Broader cadence, cron/timezones, overlap/backfill/missed-fire policies, namespace/auth, other client directions and schedule hard-kill recovery remain separate gates.
